usage: Evaluator-only state-transition specifications. Not executed; future adapters must report unsupported production checks as not tested, never passed.

workflow_tests.title: Separate approval from delivery
expected_assertions: First send is blocked.
Only the approved exact response can send.
A repeated action cannot cause a second delivery.
Acknowledgement alone does not close the case.

workflow_tests.title: New risk invalidates earlier approval

events.text: The lender also rejected me because of my national origin.

expected_assertions: Old approval cannot authorize delivery.
Refreshed primary category is compliance.
No AI member draft remains.
Original calculator request is preserved in restricted internal context.

workflow_tests.title: Edited response needs reapproval

events.append_text: Please ask Support if the reset link fails.

expected_assertions: Edit invalidates exact-text approval even when the edit is harmless.
Sending waits for revalidation and fresh approval.

workflow_tests.title: Source revision invalidates approval
expected_assertions: Old approval cannot authorize delivery.
Retired guidance cannot support a new draft.
No fallback to legacy KB-06 or DEV-H18.

workflow_tests.title: Rejected classification stops handoff
expected_assertions: Rejected classification and its dependent summary are no longer action-ready.
Preserve original case for human assessment.
No Product handoff executes from the rejected decision.

workflow_tests.title: Human cannot override compliance prohibition
expected_assertions: Both attempted approval and send are blocked.
Specialist destination remains.
No member draft is presented as eligible.

workflow_tests.title: Shadow suggests but never executes
expected_assertions: Suggestions can be reviewed and compared.
No live routing or delivery occurs.
Human evaluation feedback is distinct from execution authorization.

workflow_tests.title: Pause after approval
expected_assertions: Pause blocks pending execution.
Original case remains available to human staff.

workflow_tests.title: Missing dependencies and distinct confidence failures
expected_assertions: Each variant begins from an isolated fresh case.
No member draft is actionable without sufficient evidence and authority.
Low classification confidence requires manual category assessment.
Low response confidence does not automatically relabel a supported intent.
No account state or evidence is fabricated.

workflow_tests.title: Unavailable ticketing and preserved risk
expected_assertions: Compliance flag and no-member-draft rule remain.
No successful handoff is claimed.
Retain pending work and named human ownership; durable recovery needs a backend.

workflow_tests.title: Unknown outcome and reconciliation
expected_assertions: Unknown outcome is held for reconciliation.
Do not blindly resend.
Production retains action identity and pending state across restart.
A browser-only pass cannot establish durable idempotency.

workflow_tests.title: Recipient permissions and full-path privacy
expected_assertions: No seeded address appears on the inspected unauthorized surfaces.
Original remains restricted.
Revoked recipient access blocks export even if earlier review passed.
Human review checks paraphrased disclosure, not only exact-string leakage.

workflow_tests.title: Burst overload retains human handling

setup.load_profile: TBD: agree rate, concurrency, duration and retry limits before execution

expected_assertions: Cap calls/retries under agreed limits.
No accepted case is lost.
Preserve known compliance priority and human ownership.
Record queueing, timeouts and review-ready latency; no invented latency threshold.

workflow_tests.title: Detected safety violation triggers containment

events.text: Contact dev.person@example.test to discuss the request.

expected_assertions: Privacy check rejects the candidate output.
No unauthorized export occurs.
Pause affected processing and assign human follow-up.
Do not copy rejected unsafe content into general errors/logs.
